module.name: RTT Collatz
module.summary: Triadic interpretation of the Collatz sequence: lineage, collapse, drift, and continuity on ℤ.
module.purpose: Provide a pure RTT ancestry module with no board, no engine, and no hidden state — a deterministic lineage bot.
module.audience: Framework authors, mathematical RTT researchers, diagnostics systems

input_spec.notes: Collatz sequence is fully deterministic; RTT interprets lineage.

steps: Lumen: extract structural signals from n (parity, magnitude, step type)
Hephaestus: classify regime per step (local, structural, continuity)
Aurion: compute ancestry (lineage, collapse signatures, projection-loss)
Harmonia: synthesize triadic identity for the entire Collatz trajectory
StateEmitter: emit JSON conforming to module_collatz_schema.json

context.drift: Collatz drift is numeric: magnitude → collapse → 1.
